knowledge_gaps: The added retention gate scales the entire previous state before the GRU, affecting its update gate, reset gate, candidate state and carry path. Its benefit beyond existing GRU gating is unestablished. The proposed 'time-blind control' is ambiguous because the retention variant itself uses no timestamps; specify fixed-retention and parameter-matched controls as separate trials.

Reproduction details remain incomplete: whether the baseline has multiple recurrent layers, where retention applies, the gate input dimension after input transforms, and how baseline dropout semantics are preserved. Predictor parity should compare the training-side model and reloaded predictor with both in evaluation mode; training-versus-evaluation equality is generally inappropriate with dropout. Custom recurrence throughput also needs measurement within the shared budget.

The evaluation plan omits paired validation uncertainty and repeated-selection optimism. Single-negative training margins do not diagnose forgetting or explain ranking among 99 negatives. Originality 4 is plausible, but potential 7 and difficulty 4 remain speculative without stronger controls, verified architectural precedents and runtime evidence.
